scenes.title: 2025 University of Montreal Sleep Lab: Unconscious Sleeper Wearing High-Density EEG Cap While Cortical Waves Stay Wired
scenes.era: 2025, Center for Advanced Research in Sleep Medicine, University of Montreal

layout.description: Dimly lit modern Montreal sleep-laboratory suite separated by an observation window: on the bed, a 48-year-old volunteer sleeps peacefully wearing a soft geodesic EEG net, while Philipp Thölke and Karim Jerbi stand at the dual-monitor waveform console comparing smooth placebo slow waves against jagged, high-complexity caffeine NREM traces.

positions.who: 48-year-old sleeping volunteer (in soft cotton sleep shirt wearing a delicate white EEG sensor cap)
positions.where: lying motionless with eyes closed on the crisp sleep-lab bed after swallowing the double-blind capsule
positions.facing: resting peacefully on side-angled pillow toward camera

positions.who: Neuroscientist researcher (in dark knit sweater and lab badge beside observation glass)
positions.where: leaning toward the glowing EEG waveform console pointing a stylus from the calm slow wave to the rapid, fragmented caffeine trace
positions.facing: angled toward the observation window and waveform display

props.name: identical twin white capsule blister cup and bedside water tumbler
props.period_detail: 2025 Montreal double-blind crossover capsule pairing caffeine against identical placebo
props.physical_behavior: State-A volunteer swallows white capsule with water at bedside -> State-B sleeps motionless while EEG cap cables transmit high-complexity NREM bursts

props.name: high-density sleep EEG sensor cap and dual-trace waveform console
props.period_detail: clinical polysomnography net capturing NREM 1/f slope flattening and cortical criticality
props.physical_behavior: State-A smooth rolling deep NREM waves under placebo -> State-B jagged fast-flickering wake-like criticality waves under caffeine

actions.verb_sequence: sets the empty capsule cup on the nightstand, switches off the warm lamp, and drifts quickly to sleep -> remains physically still while cortical sensors pulse rapidly
taps the side-by-side EEG monitor trace showing unconscious NREM brainwaves locked in wake-like complexity

reactions.reaction: widens eyes slightly seeing waking-style neural complexity inside motionless NREM sleep
wakes at 7 AM rubbing temples despite eight full hours in bed

scenes.wardrobe: Soft heather-gray sleepwear on volunteer; navy cardigan over collared shirt on researcher.
scenes.lighting: Cool moonlit blue bedroom glow contrasted against warm amber control-room desk light.
scenes.recognition_hook: Your eyes close and you sleep eight hours—yet 2025 brainwave scans catch afternoon caffeine keeping your unconscious cortex wired like daytime.

key_visual.description: a motionless adult sleeping in a soft EEG sensor cap while a sleep researcher behind glass inspects jagged wake-like brainwaves on a monitor

scenes.title: Outdoor Sunlit 3:00 PM Sidewalk Café Espresso vs 1:00 PM Cutoff Walk
scenes.era: Modern sunlit afternoon city sidewalk café patio

layout.description: Sunlit outdoor brick sidewalk café patio under green trees with wrought-iron bistro tables and an awning clock reading mid-afternoon.

positions.who: 52-year-old professional (in tailored blazer over linen shirt)
positions.where: sitting at an outdoor bistro table glancing at a wristwatch at 3:15 PM while lifting a porcelain espresso cup

props.name: white porcelain afternoon espresso cup and stainless wristwatch
props.period_detail: everyday afternoon pick-me-up inside the 8.8-hour pre-bedtime clearance window
props.physical_behavior: State-A hand lifts steaming 3:15 PM espresso cup -> State-B swaps late espresso for sparkling water with lemon slice after checking watch

actions.verb_sequence: checks wristwatch on the sunlit patio, pauses over the 3 PM espresso cup, and slides a tall glass of sparkling lemon water forward instead

reactions.reaction: smiles with relaxed afternoon composure protecting tonight's slow-wave recovery

scenes.wardrobe: Smart-casual taupe blazer, white open-collar shirt, and wristwatch.
scenes.recognition_hook: A single 107 mg cup of coffee needs nearly nine hours of clearance to leave deep slow-wave sleep untouched.
